qwen.description: The actor stands facing forward, then raises her right arm to shoulder height with palm open and fingers extended, holding the pose briefly before lowering the arm back down. Her head turns slightly toward the raised hand during the gesture.

qwen.description: The actor stands facing forward, then raises her right hand with palm open and facing left, while her left hand moves forward to meet it, palm also open and facing right — as if framing or holding an invisible object between the hands. She holds this pose briefly before returning to neutral stance.
